passages.note: Assembly Floor concurrence vote; Gipson is listed among the Ayes.
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 48 Noes Count 31 NVR Count 1

passages.provision_quote: the state board shall ensure that statewide greenhouse gas emissions are reduced to at least 40 percent below the statewide greenhouse gas emissions limit no later than December 31, 2030
passages.note: Operative text sets an emissions-reduction target, not a clean-energy mandate (H17).

rows.reasoning: SB 32's operative clause only directs the Air Resources Board to ensure statewide greenhouse gas emissions are reduced to at least 40 percent below the 1990 limit by December 31, 2030; this is an emissions target the board may meet by any means and names no clean-energy source, so it cannot establish 'Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines' (V4.2, H17). Gipson's Aye vote on the Assembly concurrence (Ayes 48, Noes 31) shows only that he favored this emissions-reduction approach, not which rung's mechanism he supports.
